name: Reginald Vancaskerkin AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

defensiveAbilities.name: Clockwork Reconstruction
defensiveAbilities.description: Each time Reginald is reborn in his lair, his machines graft him with a new clockwork modification. He chooses one of his abilities with the clockwork trait. He gains access to this ability but can't use any of his other clockwork abilities. He can't choose the same ability twice in a row. He begins with Ink Blood active.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ink Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
Reginald's body is filled with toxic ink

Trigger An adjacent creature Strikes Reginald with a melee weapon or unarmed attack and deals damage

Effect The creature is exposed to Reginald's poison ink.

defensiveAbilities.name: Secret of Rebirth
defensiveAbilities.description: If a creature with less than 5 Secret Knowledge points reduces Reginald to 0 HP (or dealt the last damage to him before he dies from using Overdrive Engine), Reginald's body dissipates into a puddle of ink and releases a black wave of psychic energy. Each creature within 30 feet is bathed in a torrent of forbidden secrets and gains 1 Secret Knowledge point. Reginald's body reforms 1d6 rounds later in his sanctum at full health at a location of his choosing (typically the Pool of Secrets, area L11). This ability activates automatically with no action necessary on Vancaskerkin's behalf.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: Reginald's lungs are equipped with ink canisters, allowing him to spew a 60ft Line of ink that deals 9d6 Poison Damage damage (Basic DC 39 Reflex Saving Throw save; on a failure, the creature is also subjected to Reginald's poison ink).

offensiveAbilities.name: Overdrive Engine
offensiveAbilities.description:
Reginald is equipped with clockwork organs to power his body

Requirements Reginald has 175 Hit Points or fewer

Effect Reginald gains 200 temporary Hit Points, a +15-foot status bonus to Speed, and a +2 status bonus to melee attack rolls. His body begins to overheat, spewing steam that deals 9d6 Fire Damage damage at the beginning of his turn to all creatures within 30 feet (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). After 2 rounds, Reginald explodes, dealing 19d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures within 60 feet (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). Reginald dies. For the purposes of his Secret of Rebirth ability, the last creature to damage Reginald counts as killing him.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Ink
offensiveAbilities.description:
Reginald is immune to the toxic ink that flows through his veins

Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage and Sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage Sickened 2 (1 round).

offensiveAbilities.name: Quill Cannon
offensiveAbilities.description: Reginald is equipped with a cannon and hundreds of steel quills. He makes two steel quill attacks against every creature in a 60ft Cone, ignoring the multiple attack penalty until after all attacks are made. He can't use Quill Cannon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reflective Plating
offensiveAbilities.description: Reginald engages his defensive plating, which casts Spell Turning on him (counteract modifier +32).

offensiveAbilities.name: Slither
offensiveAbilities.description: With his body composed of ink and gears, Reginald can move through tight spaces as if he were a Tiny creature, treating them as difficult terrain.
